method: official per-assay Spearman of each expert's own OOF predictions, no fusion
findings: seed averaging lifts the standalone score far more than the fusion score: +0.030 for union and +0.023 for lr8 standalone, versus +0.0012 and +0.0022 in the fusion
the final expert scores 0.644877 alone, close to but still below the strongest single expert Kermut (0.6625), yet still earns +0.0054 in the fusion
the fusion adds +0.0536 on top of the encoder, and that part comes from decorrelation between experts, not from the encoder itself
